Load kstitch results from disk

Source: R/tpca_bridge.R
load_kstitch_results.Rd

Unified loader for results previously saved by run_tpca, compute_nmf, or link_shape_and_factors when called with return_results = FALSE.

load_kstitch_results(
  path,
  type = c("tpca", "nmf", "cca"),
  load_pre_shape = TRUE
)

Arguments

path

For type = "tpca": path to the output directory containing TPCA_Info.h5 and Shape_Metadata.csv.gz. For type = "nmf" or type = "cca": path to an RDS file.

type

One of "tpca", "nmf", or "cca".

load_pre_shape

Logical. For type = "tpca" only: whether to load the pre-shape embedding from Pre_Shape_Space_Embedding.h5 into Info$pre_shape_embedding. Default TRUE. Set to FALSE to skip loading this (potentially large) array when it is not needed.

Value

For "tpca": a flat list with TPCA_Embedding, Info (variances, v_matrix, frechet_mean, pre_shape_embedding), Metadata, and contour_type. For "nmf" or "cca": the deserialised RDS list.

See also

run_tpca, compute_nmf, link_shape_and_factors
